title: Swarley
novel:
Barney walked into the [[coffee shop|coffee shop]] as usual, but the barista called out "Swarley" instead of his real name. Everyone in the [[gang|gang]] heard it. Within five minutes, nobody called him Barney anymore.

"My name is Barney, not Swarley!" he [[protested|protest]], but the more he [[resisted|resist]], the [[funnier|funny]] it became. Ted started [[grinning|grin]] every time. Marshall even changed Barney's name in his phone. "Swarley," he read it out loud and nearly [[collapsed|collapse]] with [[laughter|laugh]].

Meanwhile, Ted met a girl named [[Chloe|Chloe]] at the coffee shop. She was a baker with [[flour|flour]] on her [[cheeks|cheek]] and a smile that made him forget his own name. But there was a problem — she was [[completely|complete]] [[insane|insane]]. She talked to her [[plants|plant]], [[believed|believe]] in [[aliens|alien]], and insisted that her cat was a [[reincarnated|reincarnate]] [[pharaoh|pharaoh]].

"I can't date a crazy person," Ted told Barney. "Or can I?"

"You absolutely should not," Barney — Swarley — said. "But also, that's exactly what you're going to do, because you're Ted Mosby, and you are [[physically|physical]] [[incapable|incapable]] of avoiding bad [[decisions|decision]]."

He was right. Ted went on a second date. And a third.

At the end of the week, Barney finally [[snapped|snap]]. "If one more person calls me Swarley, I am moving to [[Chicago|Chicago]]!" The gang [[agreed|agree]] to stop — right after they [[threw|throw]] him a "Goodbye Swarley" party.

coffee shop.en: a small restaurant where coffee, tea, and cakes are served

gang.en: a group of close friends who spend time together

protest.en: to say or show that you strongly disagree with something

resist.en: to try to stop something from happening or to fight against it

grin.en: to smile widely showing your teeth

collapse.en: to fall down suddenly, especially because of weakness or laughter

laughter.en: the sound or act of laughing

flour.en: a white powder made from wheat used for making bread and cakes

cheek.en: the soft part of your face below your eyes

plant.en: a living thing that grows in the earth, with leaves and roots

believe.en: to think that something is true or real

alien.en: a creature from a different planet

reincarnate.en: to be born again in a new body after death

physically.en: in a way that relates to the body

decision.en: a choice you make after thinking about it

snap.en: to suddenly lose control of your emotions

agree.en: to say yes to an idea or plan

throw.en: to send something through the air; to organize a party
